body:
I should be able to use iPad Pro and Apple Pencil and all other similar hardware to draw a line. The start of the line is the start of a link, the end of a line is an end of a link. And the middle of a line is the center of a link.

Yet the path can be kept close to original.

That demo should be mobile first and should work also at tablets and so on.

It should allow to get links similar to blueprint.html, but with path constructed with freely placed intermediate points. Start, end and center points should still be present.

We should name it draw.html, it should support to draw links from center points of other links. So when started or finished at center point it next link should be pinned to the center of initially existing link. So we should support as many links drawing as possible.

Drawing a line gives us all the data, the first point is start, the end point is end, and the point in the middle of drawn path is the center of a link.

Make sure to use exactly the same style of all elements as in blueprint.html, so all proportions, sizes, colors everything is kept exactly with that style. We may need to introduce additional flexible arrow shaped link.

And we need two imput modes - select and move (to adjust moving points) and draw mode (to actually draw new links, and don't recognize the same action as move of center of another link).

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: We need to have drawing to link conversion demo
